results.artistName: Gwyn McNamee, Claire Marti, Kait Nolan, Kat Baxter, Kimberly Quinn, Liz Alden, Samantha Baca, Scarlett Finn & Shaw Hart
results.description:
Whether you met as children, in high school or college, became roommates or next door neighbors as adults, your best friend has stood by your side through countless trials and tribulations of life, but falling for your best friend means finding the kind of passion and love that can only come with the person who knows you the best. Experience these 10 unique steamy stories about falling in love with the person right in front of you...
